answers.core: This will really ease the things, especially given that this looks to be a very simple to implement. I don't believe this can introduce any compatibility issues or has any hidden corner cases we need consider.
answers.workaround:
In theory, this possibly can be worked around like following (considering `intersect_ray()` physics query):

1. Do the raycast
2. Check if the collider is one of CSGShape3D shapes that you want to exclude
3. If yes - add its `RID` to exclusions and repeat from step 1

This, however, makes the code a little bit more complex and less performant
